requirements.title: User Login
requirements.text: User Login. The system shall authenticate users with an email address and password.

requirements.title: The system shall lock an account after five consecutive failed login attempts
requirements.text: The system shall lock an account after five consecutive failed login attempts.

requirements.title: Password Reset
requirements.text: Password Reset. Users must be able to reset a forgotten password via a time-limited email link, as per FR-2.

requirements.title: Session timeout
requirements.text: Session timeout. Sessions shall expire after 30 minutes of inactivity and require re-authentication.

requirements.title: Profile update
requirements.text: Profile update. The system shall let users update their display name and avatar. Acceptance criteria: Changes are visible after refresh.

requirements.title: Data export
requirements.text: Data export. The system shall export all personal data as JSON. The export must complete within 24 hours.

requirements.title: The system shall permanently delete an account within
requirements.text: The system shall permanently delete an account within 30 days of a verified request.

requirements.title: Change audit trail
requirements.text: Change audit trail. The system shall keep an audit trail of profile changes. Audit entries must be retained for one year.

requirements.title: Audit Logging
requirements.text: Audit Logging. The system shall record every administrative action with a timestamp and actor.

requirements.title: Email Notifications
requirements.text: Email Notifications. The system shall email users when their password changes.

requirements.title: Response Time
requirements.text: Response Time. Ninety-five percent of API requests shall complete within 300 milliseconds.

requirements.title: Encryption
requirements.text: Encryption. All personal data shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256.
